units.source: Lucky888 was developed as a Bathala simulation twin for mathematical analysis and game design evaluation. The prototype reconstructs the reference game’s observable 6×5-reel structure, symbol set, tumble mechanic, Bathala elimination skill, Scatter behaviour, Free Game behaviour, and multiplier system. Gameplay rules that can be directly verified through observation have been reproduced as closely as possible. However, as the underlying probabilities and gameplay parameters cannot be directly verified, the simulation twin uses configurable datasets (JSON & CSV files) that can be easily imported, adjusted, and exported out via the HTML5-based workbench.
